00081 #define BinaryOpSymbolUGenProcessBlock(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_, OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL)              \
00082     const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                            \
00083     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                                \
00084     const float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);     \
00085     const float* rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);     \
00086                                                             \
00087     for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; ++i) {                                  \
00088       outputSamples[i] = leftOperandSamples[i] OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL rightOperandSamples[i];              \
00089     }
00090

00092 #define BinaryOpSymbolUGenProcessBlock_K(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_, OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL)              \
00093     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();                            \
00094     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;                               \
00095     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                              \
00096     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                                \
00097     float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);         \
00098     float* rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);       \
00099                                                             \
00100     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;                                 \
00101                                                             \
00102       while(numSamplesToProcess > 0) {                                      \
00103         float nextValue = value;                                        \
00104         if(numKrSamples == 0)                                         \
00105           nextValue = *leftOperandSamples OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightOperandSamples;               \
00106                                                             \
00107         numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;                                \
00108                                                             \
00109         blockPosition   += numKrSamples;                                  \
00110         leftOperandSamples  += numKrSamples;                                  \
00111         rightOperandSamples += numKrSamples;                                  \
00112                                                             \
00113         if(nextValue == value) {                                        \
00114           while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                            \
00115             *outputSamples++ = nextValue;                                 \
00116             --numSamplesToProcess;                                      \
00117             --numKrSamples;                                         \
00118           }                                                 \
00119         } else {                                                \
00120           float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) / (float)UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();          \
00121           while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                            \
00122             *outputSamples++ = value;                                   \
00123             value += valueSlope;                                      \
00124             --numSamplesToProcess;                                      \
00125             --numKrSamples;                                         \
00126           }                                                 \
00127           value = nextValue;                                          \
00128         }                                                   \
00129       }                                                     \
00130

00134     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                                \
00135     const float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_);      \

00137                                                             \
00138     for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; ++i) {                                  \
00139       outputSamples[i] = OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(leftOperandSamples[i], rightOperandSamples[i]);            \
00140     }

00143 #define BinaryOpFunctionUGenProcessBlock_K(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_, OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL)            \
00144     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();                            \
00145     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;                               \
00146     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                              \

00150                                                             \
00151     int numKrSamples = blockPosition & krBlockSize;                                 \
00152                                                             \
00153       while(numSamplesToProcess > 0) {                                      \
00154         float nextValue = value;                                        \
00155         if(numKrSamples == 0)                                         \
00156           nextValue = OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(*leftOperandSamples, *rightOperandSamples);             \
00157                                                             \
00158         numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;                                \
00159                                                             \
00160         blockPosition   += numKrSamples;                                  \
00161         leftOperandSamples  += numKrSamples;                                  \

00163                                                             \

00168             --numKrSamples;                                         \
00169           }                                                 \
00170         } else {                                                \
00171           float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) / (float)UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();          \
00172           while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                            \
00173             *outputSamples++ = value;                                   \

00410   Buffer Buffer::operator OPSYMBOL (Buffer const& rightOperand) const throw()                     \
00411   {                                                         \
00412     const int newNumChannels = numChannels_ > rightOperand.numChannels_ ? numChannels_ : rightOperand.numChannels_; \
00413     const int maxSize = size_ > rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                  \
00414     const int minSize = size_ < rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                  \
00415     const int diffSize = maxSize-minSize;                                     \
00416                                                             \
00417     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(maxSize, newNumChannels, false));                         \
00418                                                             \
00419     for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < newNumChannels; channelIndex++)                    \
00420     {                                                       \
00421       int numSamples;                                               \
00422       float* leftSamples = channels[channelIndex % numChannels_]->data;                     \
00423       float* rightSamples = rightOperand.channels[channelIndex % rightOperand.numChannels_]->data;        \
00424       float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;                        \
00425                                                             \
00426       if(size_ == 1 && numChannels_ == 1) {                                   \
00427         numSamples = maxSize;                                         \
00428                                                             \
00429         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        \
00430           *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples++;                  \
00431         }                                                   \
00432       } else if(rightOperand.size_ == 1 && rightOperand.numChannels_ == 1) {                    \
00433         numSamples = maxSize;                                         \
00434                                                             \
00435         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        \
00436           *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples;                  \
00437         }                                                   \
00438       } else {                                                  \
00439         numSamples = minSize;                                         \
00440         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        \
00441           *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples++;                \
00442         }                                                   \
00443                                                             \
00444         numSamples = diffSize;                                          \
00445         if(size_ > rightOperand.size_) {                                    \
00446           while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                      \
00447             *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL 0.f;                    \
00448           }                                                 \
00449         }                                                   \
00450         else if(rightOperand.size_ > size_) {                                 \
00451           while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                      \
00452             *outputSamples++ = 0.f OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples++;                   \
00453           }                                                 \
00454         }                                                   \
00455       }                                                     \
00456     }                                                       \
00457                                                             \
00458     return newBuffer;                                               \
00459   }                                                         \

00495       ValueArray newArray(maxSize);                                       \

00855 template<BinaryOpFunction op>
00856 class BinaryOpUGenInternalT : public BinaryOpUGenInternal
00857 {
00858 public:
00859   BinaryOpUGenInternalT(UGen const& leftOperand, UGen const& rightOperand)
00860   : BinaryOpUGenInternal(leftOperand, rightOperand)
00861   {
00862   }
00863   
00864   UGenInternal* getChannel(const int channel) throw()
00865   {
00866     return new BinaryOpUGenInternalT<op>(inputs[LeftOperand].getChannel(channel),
00867                        inputs[RightOperand].getChannel(channel));
00868   }
00869   
00870   UGenInternal* getKr() throw();
00871   
00872   float getValue(const int channel) const throw()                   
00873   {                                                         
00874     return op(inputs[LeftOperand].getValue(channel), inputs[RightOperand].getValue(channel));   
00875   } 
00876   
00877   void processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw() 
00878   { 
00879     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize(); 
00880     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData(); 
00881     const float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00882     const float* rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00883     
00884     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00885     {
00886       *outputSamples++ = op(*leftOperandSamples++,
00887                   *rightOperandSamples++);
00888     }
00889   }
00890 };

00892 template<BinaryOpFunction op>
00893 class BinaryOpUGenInternalTK : public BinaryOpUGenInternalT<op>
00894 {
00895 private:
00896   float value;
00897   
00898 public:
00899   BinaryOpUGenInternalTK(UGen const& leftOperand, UGen const& rightOperand) throw()
00900   : BinaryOpUGenInternalT<op>(leftOperand, rightOperand), value(0.f)
00901   {
00902     this->rate = UGenInternal::ControlRate;
00903   }
00904   
00905   UGenInternal* getChannel(const int channel) throw()
00906   {
00907     return new BinaryOpUGenInternalTK<op>(this->inputs[BinaryOpUGenInternal::LeftOperand].getChannel(channel),
00908                         this->inputs[BinaryOpUGenInternal::RightOperand].getChannel(channel));
00909   }
00910   
00911   UGenInternal* getKr() throw() { this->incrementRefCount(); return this; } 
00912   
00913   void processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw() 
00914   {
00915     const unsigned int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();                           
00916     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;                               
00917     int numSamplesToProcess = this->uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                              
00918     float* outputSamples = this->uGenOutput.getSampleData();                                
00919     float* leftOperandSamples = this->inputs[BinaryOpUGenInternal::LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);         
00920     float* rightOperandSamples = this->inputs[BinaryOpUGenInternal::RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);       
00921     
00922     int numKrSamples = blockPosition & krBlockSize;                                 
00923     
00924     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0) {                                      
00925       float nextValue = value;                                        
00926       if(numKrSamples == 0)                                         
00927         nextValue = op(*leftOperandSamples, *rightOperandSamples);              
00928       
00929       numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;                                
00930       
00931       blockPosition   += numKrSamples;                                  
00932       leftOperandSamples  += numKrSamples;                                  
00933       rightOperandSamples += numKrSamples;                                  
00934       
00935       if(nextValue == value) {                                        
00936         while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                            
00937           *outputSamples++ = nextValue;                                 
00938           --numSamplesToProcess;                                      
00939           --numKrSamples;                                         
00940         }                                                 
00941       } else {                                                
00942         float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) / (float)UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();          
00943         while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                            
00944           *outputSamples++ = value;                                   
00945           value += valueSlope;                                      
00946           --numSamplesToProcess;                                      
00947           --numKrSamples;                                         
00948         }                                                 
00949         value = nextValue;                                          
00950       }                                                   
00951     }                                                         
00952   }
00953 };

00957 {
00958   return new BinaryOpUGenInternalTK<op>(inputs[LeftOperand].kr(),
00959                       inputs[RightOperand].kr());

00974 template<BinaryOpFunction op>
00975 class BinaryOpUGenT : public UGen
00976 {
00977 public:
00978   BinaryOpUGenT(UGen const& leftOperand, UGen const& rightOperand) throw()
00979   {
00980     const int numRightChannels = rightOperand.getNumChannels();
00981     const int numLeftChannels = leftOperand.getNumChannels();
00982     
00983     if(numLeftChannels > numRightChannels) 
00984       initInternal(numLeftChannels); 
00985     else 
00986       initInternal(numRightChannels); 
00987     
00988     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++) 
00989     { 
00990       internalUGens[i] = new BinaryOpUGenInternalT<op>(leftOperand,rightOperand);
00991       internalUGens[i]->initValue(op(leftOperand.getValue(i),
00992                        rightOperand.getValue(i)));
00993     }
00994     
00995   }
00996   
00997   static UGen AR(UGen const& leftOperand, UGen const& rightOperand) { return BinaryOpUGenT<op>(leftOperand, rightOperand); }
00998   static UGen KR(UGen const& leftOperand, UGen const& rightOperand) { return UGen(BinaryOpUGenT<op>(leftOperand.kr(), 
00999                                                     rightOperand.kr())).kr(); }
01000 };
